title: cinematic.narration_word
description: M12C § ElevenLabs narration sync. Fires once per word as the cinematic playhead crosses the word's `start_ms` (from `<id>.narration_track.json`). Always emitted for replay parity; the caption ribbon is hidden when `captions_enabled=false`. Per spec § 'cinematic.narration_word events still emit (replay parity)'.
